## Purpose

## Security and information boundaries

- [ ] Authorization, Site/work-level isolation, audit and lifecycle effects were assessed.
- [ ] No secret, customer data, personal data, private address or generated local artifact is included.

## Verification

## Maintainer note

Fylkren does not accept unsolicited external code contributions. This template supports owner-controlled maintenance and automated dependency updates.
